lint.command: uv run ruff check src/ tests/

blockingIssues.description: VAL-CROSS-001 test coverage is incomplete: lifecycle test omits required pull step and /v1/models HTTP 200 verification.
VAL-CROSS-007 propagation checks are weak/vacuous and can pass without proving litellm-port or memory-budget propagation.
Default-quant pull propagation test conditionally skips assertions when pull exits non-zero, allowing false positives.
VAL-CROSS-012 checks do not verify estimated-label removal and do not assert scoring/ranking impact from saved benchmarks.
VAL-CROSS-013 models consistency test does not invoke the models command and therefore does not validate command/file consistency.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit orchestrator-side preflight to ensure each feature's declared skill is actually available to workers before assignment; if unavailable, assign a valid fallback skill and record that decision.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature misc-cross-area-validation declares skillName=cli-feature, but the worker transcript reports "Skill \"cli-feature\" not found" while a project skill file exists, causing procedural deviation.
